SELECT s.id subject_id,count(DISTINCT b.id) FILTER(WHERE q.id IS NOT NULL) bank_count,count(q.id) question_count, count(f.question_id) answered_count,count(f.question_id) FILTER(WHERE f.judgment='CORRECT') correct_count,count(f.question_id) FILTER(WHERE f.judgment='WRONG') wrong_count,count(f.question_id) FILTER(WHERE f.judgment='WRONG' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM totals t WHERE t.question_id=f.question_id AND t.wrong_count>0)) wrong_book_count FROM subject s LEFT JOIN question_bank b ON b.subject_id=s.id AND b.id IN (SELECT id FROM visible_question_bank) LEFT JOIN active_question q ON q.bank_id=b.id AND NOT q.is_group LEFT JOIN facts f ON f.question_id=q.id AND f.rn=1 WHERE s.id IN #{id} GROUP BY s.id
